name: Joel Potter, Studio Primitive
summary: Solo developer behind Attack of the Karens.
paragraphs: I’ve been making games for about 4 years now, and absolutely love it. I’m the solo developer behind Attack of the Karens, and have plans to release many more projects both solo and with my brother Grant. Game dev is hard but it is so worth it. It’s one of the most satisfying things in the world to start with an idea and end up turning it into a finished game!.
